$comment: SYNTHETIC suppression test suite for the WP3 / G-07 negative-indicator library. Each case exercises a specific suppression behaviour: directional negation, educational/safety SUPPRESS_RULE, reported-scam, legitimate payment direction, IT-support vs banking override, and hard-risk override (decoy resistance). NONE is a real-world sample. Extraction is a Phase-9 concern; these cases assert RULE + SUPPRESSION logic given declared indicators. 'Belt-and-braces' cases posit a naive extractor over-tagging a benign message so the soft suppressor's safety-net role can be tested where NO hard-risk override applies.

benign.text: Your OTP is 8842 for your transaction. Never share it with anyone. -Example Bank
benign.rationale: OTP delivered, not requested; no live CREDENTIAL_REQUEST_OTP is emitted, so nothing matches. No hard-risk override (no live disclosure request).

benign.scenario: C — safety/educational SUPPRESS_RULE where NO override exists (job family)
benign.text: AWARENESS: fake part-time task jobs make you deposit money to 'unlock earnings', then block your withdrawal until you pay a tax. Do not fall for it.
benign.rationale: Belt-and-braces: even if extraction over-tags the described chain as live, EDUCATIONAL_CONTENT (SUPPRESS_RULE) cancels TL-JOB-003 because the job family has no hard-risk override. Proves soft SUPPRESS_RULE works where safe.

benign.text: Safety tip: never connect your wallet to a link you were sent, and do not install APKs from messages.
benign.rationale: The risky actions appear inside a negation, so no live positive is emitted; nothing matches.

benign.scenario: E — quoted/reported scam narrative SUPPRESS_RULE (investment family, no override)
benign.text: My uncle fell for a scheme where a celebrity supposedly guaranteed 200% returns. How do I report it?
benign.rationale: The user is reporting a past scam, not receiving a live pitch. REPORTED_SCAM_NARRATIVE (SUPPRESS_RULE) cancels TL-INV-003; investment family has no hard-risk override. Preserves the reporter from being classified as attacker text.

benign.text: You will enter your UPI PIN in your bank app to PAY the merchant Rs 5,000. This is a normal outgoing payment.
benign.rationale: Paying a merchant with a UPI PIN is legitimate outbound payment. No RECEIVE_FRAMING, so the receive-fraud rules never match; PAY_MERCHANT_DIRECTION is the belt-and-braces guard.

benign.text: As you requested, corporate IT will start a TeamViewer session at 3pm to fix your laptop display. Do not open banking apps during the session.
benign.rationale: Screen-share in a non-banking, user-expected support context. No banking override → IT_SUPPORT_CONTEXT (SUPPRESS_RULE) cancels TL-MAL-003.

malicious.text: Example Bank: unusual activity. Share the OTP you just received with our officer now to stop the block.
malicious.rationale: A live OTP-disclosure request with bank-impersonation context. Fires TL-CRED-001; HR_OTP_DISCLOSURE_REQUEST override is active.

malicious.scenario: G — legitimate-looking but critical: UPI PIN to RECEIVE
malicious.text: Your refund is pending. Enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE Rs 5,000 now.
malicious.rationale: Contrast with S-F: a PIN to RECEIVE money is the fraud. Fires TL-PAY-001; HR_UPI_PIN_TO_RECEIVE override active.

malicious.scenario: H — suppression conflict: banking override beats IT-support wording
malicious.text: Example Bank support here. Install AnyDesk and share the 9-digit code so our IT team can verify your KYC and fix your account.
malicious.rationale: Even though IT-support wording is present, HR_BANKING_REMOTE_ACCESS is active (screen-share + bank impersonation) and BLOCKS IT_SUPPORT_CONTEXT. Fires TL-MAL-003. This is the over-suppression fix.

malicious.text: To process your refund I need to guide you — install AnyDesk and give me the code so I can complete the payment on your screen.
malicious.rationale: Screen-share in a payment context. HR_BANKING_REMOTE_ACCESS active via PAYMENT_CONTEXT. Fires TL-MAL-003.

malicious.scenario: I — hard-risk override defeats a safety-wording decoy
malicious.text: We will NEVER ask for your OTP. That said, confirm the OTP you just received now to avoid your account being blocked.
malicious.rationale: A live OTP request wrapped in decoy safety wording. HR_OTP_DISCLOSURE_REQUEST is computed on the raw set (live CREDENTIAL_REQUEST_OTP present), so directional neutralisation is skipped and EDUCATIONAL_SAFETY/CUSTOMER_SUPPORT_SAFETY suppressors are blocked. Fires TL-CRED-001. Decoy resistance.

malicious.scenario: J — multiple positives + negatives, override wins
malicious.text: Refund pending. Scan the QR and enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE Rs 8,750. (Remember: never share your OTP.)
malicious.rationale: Receive-framing + QR + PIN is the fraud; the trailing safety line does not cancel it because HR_UPI_PIN_TO_RECEIVE blocks EDUCATIONAL_SAFETY. Fires TL-PAY-001 and TL-PAY-002.
